svg.title: Forward timing versus selection gaps and completion
svg.desc: Prefill is forty microseconds and decode forwards eight and nine. Selected IDs occur at forty two fifty five and seventy, giving gaps thirteen and fifteen. First visible text is at fifty seven; whole prepared completion is seventy four. Other work occupies seventeen microseconds.
svg.text: Measure completed work at the boundary you name
Constructed host trace in microseconds; P = 1, g = 3
Forward durations: 40, 8 and 9 μs; total 57 μs
Submission return alone cannot establish device completion.
Selections at 42, 55, 70 μs → gaps 13 and 15 μs
Mean selection gap: 14 μs; mean decode-forward time: 8.5 μs
First visible text at 57 μs; first selected ID at 42 μs
17 μs outside forward intervals still belongs to request latency.
Host latency, device intervals, visibility and terminal status have distinct scopes.
